user.title: Yeelight Cube Matrix
user.description: Enter the IP address of the lamp. LAN control must be on in the Yeelight app. Reserve this IP in your router, the integration finds the lamp by it

error.cannot_connect: Can't connect to the lamp. Check the IP address and that LAN control is on
error.wrong_model: This lamp is not a Cube Matrix

abort.already_configured: This lamp is already set up

layout.title: Module layout
layout.description: List the modules in chain order, split by commas, for example: matrix, spot, matrix

preset_add.title: Add a preset
preset_add.description: A preset is one art in the pixel art format. It is shared by all cubes, and a saved preset wins over a file or built-in one with the same name

show.name: Show
show.description: Plays pixel art or an effect on the cube, then goes back to the background or to what then says

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Name of a preset to play. Give this or definition, not both

definition.name: Definition
definition.description: One art in the pixel art format, as YAML text or a mapping. Give this or preset, not both

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: How many times an animation plays, or forever

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the show lasts in seconds. Without it a still picture or an effect stays 5 seconds

fps.name: Frames per second
fps.description: Speed of the animation, instead of the art's own fps

then.name: Then
then.description: What comes after the show: restore (the background), hold (keep the last frame), off (black) or a preset name

fit.name: Fit
fit.description: What to do when the art size is not the cube size: error, center or tile

wait.name: Wait
wait.description: Finish the action only when the show part ends

wake.name: Wake
wake.description: Play the show even when the cube is off, then turn the lamp off again

set_background.name: Set background
set_background.description: Sets what the cube shows when no show is playing

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Name of a preset, or off for black

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Ends the current show and goes back to the background

reload_presets.name: Reload presets
reload_presets.description: Reads the preset files in the cubematrix folder of the config folder again
